data.title: Vivy · 无人舞台的白蓝花嫁
data.description: 【游乐园无人剧场·清晨】Vivy穿着白蓝色舞台婚纱站在空舞台中央，耳机与白靴被礼花灯光勾出轮廓；她把一束小白花放在钢琴上，向镜头唱出只为一个约定保留的无声开场。
data.action: 空舞台中央把白花放上钢琴，向镜头完成只为约定保留的无声开场
data.lighting: clear dawn light across stage dust and white boots
data.mood: 为约定而唱的 AI 花嫁
data.promptProse: Vivy from Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song wears an opaque white-and-blue bridal stage dress with covered shoulders, a translucent veil, earpiece and white boots. She stands on the empty theater stage with a small white bouquet resting on the piano. Her precise posture loosens as she turns toward the viewer and begins the first silent count, preserving one promised song even before the audience arrives. clear dawn light across stage dust and white boots.
